chunks: And from him, from a number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Muhammad ibn al-Hasan ibn Shummun, from Abdullah ibn al-Rahman, from Mis'mam, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)

Regarding a man who made the divorce of his wife in the hands of two men, one of them divorced her and the other refused, so Ali (peace be upon him) rejected validating that until they both agree on the divorce together.

key_terms.بِيَدِ: In the hand of / delegated to

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if one of two delegated divorce agents divorces the wife while the other refuses?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) establishes that for a delegated divorce to be valid, both appointed agents must concur in the act of pronouncing it, preventing unilateral action by one agent. This ruling underscores the principle of joint agency in fiqh, ensuring that the husband's intent is fully realized through the collective execution of the delegated authority. It highlights the precision required in marital law to avoid ambiguity in the status of the wife.
